transform.identity_rule: provider_id is occurrence identity; title is only an attribute
transform.content_disposition: The expanded occurrence contains the frozen occurrence's currently observed CONCEITOS baseline and has subsequently accumulated additional rows/tabs. This supports an extension relationship at the observed content surface, but does not prove provider-level copy ancestry.

gaps.missing_field: provider-level copy/creation ancestry or an earlier receipt explicitly linking the two fileIds

gaps.evidence_needed: receipt, event log, source copy identifier, or other provider-bound evidence proving replica_of/derived_from
gaps.falsifier: evidence that the two files were independently generated from a third source despite matching baseline cells
gaps.next_probe: search receipts/registries for both provider IDs and inspect creation-time provenance references
gaps.owner_authority: Google Drive provider metadata + RAFAELIA custody registry
gaps.closure_gate: explicit provider-bound or receipt-bound ancestry edge
